scope: Proposition 4.5 (The projective period quotient) of the manuscript “Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Orbifold-and-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b143366cc99615e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In Theorem 3.1, after modifications there is a map p : B′ → S with connected fibers to a smooth projective variety and a nef rational line P with τ∗L = p∗P. On a dense open subset S◦, the retained adjoint variation of Theorem 4.3 descends, has the same connected algebraic monodromy, and has a generically immersive period map. The line P is its parabolically extended highest-weight line, up to the positive scaling already described. If the retained collection is empty, L is rationally trivial and S may be a point.
